text:
deploy-bot: [DEPLOY REQUEST] expedited hotfix rInf-service@3.2.1-hotfix -> eu-west1

Reason: spike of Tokenize->OOB errors for long prompts since 23:04 UTC. Canary planned: single node 5% traffic. Change window: 23:30-00:30 UTC. Required approvals: 2 eng + oncall.

maya: I reproduced locally, failure triggered by kv-cache miss on long prefix. Fix included.

jordan: Oncall, can you confirm rollback readiness? We may need to skip staged canary to reduce impact.

lee-ops: Snapshots taken: pv-20260320-2145, preflight smoke ok. Rollback job ready:
```
kubectl rollout undo deployment/rinf-service --to-revision=125
```
Can rollback in ~4-6 minutes.

ashley-releng: We usually require full canary, skipping means ops sign-off. I'm +1 for expedited if rollback is ready and perf baseline validated.

samir-ml: Suggest pin to model variant `rInf-gptq-1.9` to avoid extra cold-start quant warming. Patch includes pin.

maya: performance tests show 8-12% latency bump when not pinned; pin included in manifest.

jordan: I'm +1. oncall-bot, confirm incident severity and approve expedited.

oncall-bot: INCIDENT: #INC-2026-0319-euw-tokenizer, severity=high. Auto-approval blocked. Manual ack required.

lee-ops: I ack and take ownership for rollback. +1 from ops.

ashley-releng: +1 from release

maya: +1 from eng

deploy-bot: Approvals recorded: maya, jordan, lee-ops, ashley-releng.

deploy-bot: Starting accelerated rollout: canaries -> 20% after 5m smoke, full rollout 30m if stable. Will monitor token-error-rate and latency. If token-error-rate > 1% or 95p latency > 450ms, auto-roll back.

jordan: Will watch metrics and cut if we see regressions. Tagging #incidents for visibility.

samir-ml: Post-deploy: run eval set `tokenization-long-prompts` and share results.

maya: noted. I'll trigger eval at +10m and report.

deploy-bot: Rollout started at 2119876600. Status: canary deployed to 1 pod.

lee-ops: Smoke pass. No OOBs in canary. Proceeding to 20% in 3m.

ashley-releng: Noting release note: "Fix tokenization OOB for long prompts in EU regions; model variant pinned to rInf-gptq-1.9; rollback available".

deploy-bot: Status at 2119876730: 20% rollout complete; metrics within thresholds.

jordan: +1 to continue to full. Proceed.

deploy-bot: Final rollout complete at 2119876780. No automatic rollback triggered. Closing thread. :white_check_mark:
